facts.fact: 包裹出现两周后，她开车带 Ruth 和 Talia 去 Houston 看 Taylor Swift。
facts.anchor: Two weeks after Brooks’s box of lip balm and other goodies appeared on my porch, I drive Ruth and Talia to Houston.

facts.fact: 几天前 Ruth 拉她做手工之夜：粘宝石+自制奶酪酱+连看两部《律政俏佳人》。
facts.anchor: We glued plastic gems to the sunglasses while we shared an enormous bag of chips and a bowl of her homemade queso, and watched both Legally Blonde movies, back-to-back.

facts.fact: 演出前酒吧里 Talia 打趣 Brooks Hart 如今很帅。
facts.anchor: What about you, Ash? I hear Brooks Hart is lookin’ mighty fine these days.

facts.fact: Ruth 点破她早知道 Brooks 的好感、还以为两情相悦，逼她交代。
facts.anchor: I knew he had a crush on you, but I had no idea it was reciprocated! You kissed him?! Ashton, you’d better start talking.

facts.fact: 她承认多年前派对喝多了吻过 Brooks——那是她的初吻。
facts.anchor: It’s not like that. I kissed him once. At a party. Years ago. Drank too much. He was my first kiss.

facts.fact: Talia 自称是她的第二个吻。
facts.anchor: And I was your second, right, Ash?” Talia’s eyes sparkle with mischief as she swallows down her last mouthful of beer

facts.fact: 她当面说「现在你们有我们了」，坦言很喜欢 Ruth。
facts.anchor: “Well, you have us now,” I say kindly. And I mean it. I like Ruth a lot. She’s good for my brother.

facts.fact: 散场驱车回家路上她确信老家正在治愈城市的伤。
facts.anchor: Being home is healing what the city broke in me.
